problems.pattern: Document-level vocabulary does not match the gold format: modal labels written as FullAff/PrtAff/NeutNeg/Unsp/M_report, AUTH, PAST_REF/FUTURE_REF metanodes; gold uses full-affirmative/partial-affirmative/neutral-negative/unspecified, `author` and `document-creation-time`.
problems.evidence: k_doc_format wrong in all 5 sentences (':FullAff is not a modal label', ':unsp', 'unknown constant PAST_REF')

problems.pattern: Graph carries :modstr/:modpred/:quot attributes (gold has none; modality only at document level). The scorer reads :modstr as an extra modal edge, producing duplicate wrong author edges and spurious reentrancies (modpred, quot).
problems.evidence: i_modal wrong/partial with '[from the sentence-graph modal-strength]'; g_reentrancy extra modpred/quot in s14,s15,s16

problems.pattern: Gold gives (author :full-affirmative e) to EVERY event incl. complements, coordinated and relative-clause events. Prediction used partial-affirmative for planning verbs and :Unsp parents, left embedded events without author edges, and linked non-events (company).
problems.evidence: i_modal 0.13 in s14-s18

problems.pattern: Temporal structure: events get several parents or tense metanodes; gold uses (prev main :overlap current main), (main :overlap complement/coordinate/purpose event), (time expression :overlap event), DCT :before absolute date. Predictions used :after for complements and PAST_REF.
problems.evidence: h_temporal 0.16; 'a temporal child has 2-3 parents'; wrong parent in s14-s18

problems.pattern: Attribute naming/values: :ref-person/:ref-number with capitalised values instead of :refer-person/:refer-number lowercase; plural added to ordinary nouns; aspect choices (planning verb endeavor, its complements/purpose process, relative-clause speaking state, repeated broadcast habitual).
problems.evidence: c_refer missing, c_other_attributes extra plural, c_aspect wrong in s14-s18

problems.pattern: Ordinary words translated into English (market, television, small, part) or wrongly typed; classifiers dropped though gold keeps them as :unit; partitive treated with part/part-of; common noun 电视台 turned into company/name; origin places not marked as :mod entities.
problems.evidence: a_entity_concept wrong s17,s18; a_granularity; d_peripheral_entity

problems.pattern: Role labels differ from gold dataset: :possessor (not :poss), :place (not :location/:mod), :source/:end-state for 转型, :manner for adverbs, :medium for language; ARG numbering for 转型/加入/转移/顶替.
problems.evidence: e_peripheral_labels wrong s16,s17,s18; d_core_args_event wrong

problems.pattern: Discourse connectives: 因此/有见于 give top have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause); clause linking 而/则/并 gives `and` (not contrast-91 / but-91 / :cause); sentence-initial 然而 is no but-91 wrapper.
problems.evidence: a_event_found missing have-reason-91 (s16,s17); contrast vs and (s18)

problems.pattern: Alignment of named-entity type/name/language nodes should be 0-0; coref of repeated companies/places/languages across sentences missed.
problems.evidence: j_coref_chain missing/extra s14-s18

reflect.reflection: The largest recurring cost is format drift from the gold dataset rather than semantics: modal labels, author/document-creation-time, no tense metanodes, no :modstr/:modpred/:quot in the graph, a single temporal parent, lowercase attributes with :refer-*. The small models follow the old skill literally, so I rewrite the three skills to describe the gold conventions (modality only at document level, an author edge for every event, overlap-based temporal chains, Chinese lemmas for ordinary words, gold role names, have-reason-91, aspect conventions), and add a deterministic rule step after finalize that normalises labels, strips graph-level modal attributes (converting them into author edges), drops metanode temporal edges, enforces one temporal parent per child, lowercases aspect/refer values and guarantees an author edge for each event with an :aspect.

operations.text:
TASK: annotate the Chinese sentence in UMR (Stage 1: numbered roles, aspect, modal strength at document level). Work in this order.

0. CONTEXT. Reuse variables of earlier sentences (shown in their final annotations) for coreference; copy their conventions (role-name case, concept forms). Concepts: Chinese word + sense -01 for lexical events (说-01, 播放-01); ordinary nouns, adjectives, adverbs, classifiers keep the CHINESE word without sense (市场, 电视, 小, 部分, 再度, 逐渐, 亦, 初衷, 节目). NEVER translate them into English. English labels only for abstract concepts (and, or, have-reason-91, have-mod-91, date-entity, temporal-quantity), entity types (company, city, country, country-region, language, government-organization, person, thing...) and omitted/pronoun nodes.
GRAPH ATTRIBUTES allowed: :aspect (lowercase value), :polarity -, :mode, :degree, :refer-person, :refer-number (lowercase), :quant. DO NOT write :modstr, :modpred or :quot in the graph: modality goes ONLY in the document level section.

1. EVENTS. Events: predicated processes and states, event nominals (会议, 改革, 听证会 when a process), participles / relative-clause verbs (讲粤语的移民: 移民 :ARG0-of (讲-01 :ARG1 language)), complement clauses. NOT events: property modifiers, entity nouns, auxiliaries/aspect words (了 着 过 会 能 可以 应该 开始 继续), light verbs (进行/做 + event noun: keep only the noun). Idioms and words segmented as one token = one concept. 无意/有意 + verb: 无意-01 is a predicate with :ARG1 the complement event. Be conservative with implicit events.

2. TOP NODE. One main event -> that event. Complement/purpose event is an argument/:purpose of the main event. Clauses linked by 并 / 而 / 则 / 同时 / plain juxtaposition -> `and` (:op1 :op2 ...), also for contrast with 而/则; `or` for 或; sentence-initial 然而/但是 is not a coordination (no but-91 wrapper unless two clauses are really joined). Result connectives 因此 / 所以 / 有见于 / 由于: (h / have-reason-91 :ARG1 effect-event :ARG2 cause-event(s)). 因为 inside a clause: :cause. 为了/以便/以: :purpose; 如果: :condition; 虽然: :concession; 通过/靠: :manner; 之前/之后: :temporal.
Non-verbal clauses (no real verb) use abstract predicates, aspect state: 有 have-91; 属于 belong-91; existential exist-91; 在+place have-place-91; adjective predicate have-mod-91; 是+role have-role-91 / have-org-role-92 / have-rel-role-92; 是+identity identity-91.

3. PARTICIPANTS. Numbered roles :ARG0 (agent) :ARG1 (patient/theme) :ARG2 ... per verb. Change/transfer verbs: 转型(为) :ARG0 changer, :source old state, :end-state new state; 转移 ARG1 thing, ARG2 from, ARG3 to; 顶替 ARG1 replacer, ARG2 replaced; 加入/播放 ARG0 doer, ARG1/ARG2 theme. Add clearly recoverable omitted participants (zero subjects/objects) as (p / person :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) or (t / thing ...), aligned 0-0. Pronouns: 我 1st singular, 我们 1st plural, 你 2nd, 他/她 3rd singular, 他们 3rd plural, 它 thing. Do NOT put :refer-number on ordinary nouns (移民 etc.). Reuse the same variable when the same participant recurs in the sentence (one reentrancy), e.g. shared subject of coordinated events: :ARG0 s1c.

4. NON-CORE RELATIONS: :mod (property, demonstrative, type, nationality/origin place of a noun: 香港移民 -> 移民 :mod (city/country-region ...)), :possessor (possession: X的节目), :place (locations incl. 听证会上), :source, :end-state, :goal, :start, :medium (language of a programme/channel), :manner (逐渐, adverbs), :temporal, :purpose, :cause, :condition, :concession, :duration, :frequency, :extent, :degree, :quant, :unit, :ord, :part, :topic, :age, :group, :range, :name, :wiki, :other-role, :opN.
Quantities: keep the classifier as :unit (一个频道 -> 频道 :quant 1 :unit 个; 11种语言 -> 语言 :quant 11 :unit 种). Partitive 小部分的X: X :quant (部分 :mod 小). Digits for numbers. Dates: (d / date-entity :year 1998 :month 6 :day 1) aligned 0-0, under :temporal.
Named entities: (x / TYPE :name (n / name :op1 "..." :op2 "...")), one :op per segmented word, whole name incl. 电视 / 集团 / 通讯 inside the name (新时代电视 = company named 新 时代 电视). Place names modifying a noun are entities too (city, country, country-region [香港 台湾]). 电视台 as a plain common noun stays 电视台 (with :place the entity). Type node and name node are aligned 0-0; so are language and date-entity nodes.

5. ASPECT on every event (lowercase): state (states, 讲/操 languages in relative clauses, 无意, perception/mental, non-verbal clauses); habitual (repeated/regular broadcasting, 播放 of programmes); endeavor (planning/intending verbs 计划 打算; ends without result); process (event nominals; complement or purpose events of a planning verb: what is planned; ongoing/unbounded); performance (completed, bounded events: 改变 表示 改革 转型 顶替 告吹 转移 改为). Use coarse values. Negation: :polarity - on the event.
:mode imperative / interrogative / expressive when applicable.

6. ALIGNMENT. Every variable gets a line `var: start-end` (word numbers of the input). Concept -> its word(s). Abstract nodes (and, have-reason-91, date-entity, entity type nodes, name nodes, language nodes, omitted persons) -> 0-0. Do not align a node to a word belonging to another concept.

7. DOCUMENT LEVEL (sNs0 / sentence), groups :temporal :modal :coref.
:temporal - (parent :rel child), rel describes the CHILD: :before :after :overlap :contained :depends-on. Each child appears ONCE (one parent). Pattern: absolute past date -> (document-creation-time :before sNd) and (sNd :overlap main-event); time word like 当时/后来 -> (earlier time or main event of previous sentence :overlap/:after it). Continuing narrative: (previous-sentence main event :overlap this main event). Main event :overlap each of its complement, purpose, relative-clause and coordinated events (use the first coordinated event as parent of later ones if they are sequential). Cause before effect: (cause :before effect). NEVER use PAST_REF / PRESENT_REF / FUTURE_REF; skip unclear relations.
:modal - write the speaker as `author`. (author :full-affirmative e) for EVERY event in the graph (also complements, purposes, relative-clause and embedded events), including 计划/打算 events. Other labels only for explicit cues: negation 没/不/未 -> full-negative; 可能/也许 -> neutral-affirmative; 应该/必须 -> partial-affirmative; complements of 无意/不打算 style predicates -> additionally (cpt :unspecified complement). Labels: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified. Never FullAff/PrtAff/AUTH.
:coref - (earlier :same-entity current) for entities mentioned before: pronouns, zero-pronoun nodes, repeated named companies/places/languages (same name) -> link to the most recent variable of that entity, including variables of earlier sentences; :same-event for repeated events. Previous mention first.

OUTPUT only the three sections. Check: parentheses balanced; each variable declared once; every variable has an alignment line; every event has :aspect and an author modal edge; no :modstr/:modpred/:quot.
operations.reason: Align with gold conventions: modality only at document level with full label names, author, overlap-based temporal chains, refer-* attributes, Chinese lemmas for ordinary words, gold role names, have-reason-91, aspect conventions.

operations.text:
TASK: audit the current UMR annotation of the Chinese sentence and return findings only. Do NOT rewrite it. Each finding = one line: `[section] problem -> fix` (quote the exact node/relation, give corrected text). Say nothing about checks that pass. Order by importance; prefer the guideline's coarse conservative defaults. End with "NO OTHER ISSUES" if nothing remains.

CHECKLIST
1. Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once, reentrancy by bare variable; every graph variable has one alignment line; alignment numbers fit the numbered words; abstract/entity-type/name/date/language/omitted nodes aligned 0-0; document level refers only to existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time).
2. Graph attributes: NO :modstr, :modpred, :quot anywhere in the graph (modality only at document level). Attributes lowercase (:aspect performance, :refer-person 3rd, :refer-number singular); :ref-person/:ref-number are wrong names. No :refer-number on ordinary nouns.
3. Concepts: ordinary nouns/adjectives/adverbs/classifiers stay Chinese (市场, 电视, 小, 部分), never English translations (market, television, small, part). English only for abstract concepts and entity types. Event nodes for all predicates / event nominals; none for auxiliaries (会 能 了 着 过), light verbs, modifiers.
4. Top node: result connectives 因此/所以/有见于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause); clause linking 并/而/则 -> `and` (not contrast-91/but-91); sentence-initial 然而 is not a but-91 wrapper; purpose/condition/concession etc. as :purpose/:condition/:concession on the main event.
5. Roles: numbered ARGn on lexical predicates, correct direction; participants omitted but recoverable present as person/thing (0-0). Peripheral roles: :possessor (not :poss), :place (not :location or :mod for locations), :source/:end-state for 转型, :manner for adverbs like 逐渐, :medium for language of programmes/channels, :mod for origin place of a noun (香港移民), relative clauses as :ARGn-of. Classifiers kept as :unit with :quant; partitive 小部分 -> X :quant (部分 :mod 小). Named entities: type + :name with one :opN per segmented word (whole name incl. 电视/集团), no :name on common nouns like 电视台.
6. Aspect on every event, lowercase: planning verbs endeavor; their complement/purpose events process; states/relative-clause 讲 state; completed bounded events performance; repeated broadcasts habitual; event nominals process.
7. Temporal: (parent :rel child); every child exactly once (no event with two parents); no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; time expression :overlap its event; absolute date under document-creation-time :before; previous main event :overlap current main event for continuing narrative; main event :overlap its complement/purpose/coordinated events; cause :before effect.
8. Modal: (author :full-affirmative e) for EVERY event in the graph (complements, embedded, relative-clause events too); labels only from: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified (never FullAff/PrtAff/AUTH); negated events full-negative; complement of a 无意/表示-type predicate also (cpt :unspecified complement). Only events as modal children (no company/person nodes).
9. Coref: (earlier :same-entity current) for pronouns, zero-pronoun nodes and repeated named entities (same company/place/language across sentences) - check that obvious repeats are linked to the latest earlier variable; no link to nonexistent variables.
10. Consistency with context: role names and concept forms follow earlier sentences.
operations.reason: Make critique enforce gold conventions (doc-level modality only, labels, single temporal parent, Chinese lemmas, role names) instead of the old FullAff scheme.

operations.text:
TASK: produce the final, complete UMR annotation (all three sections, nothing else). Start from the current annotation; apply each finding that is correct under the rules below (silently reject findings that contradict them); also fix any other violation. Keep everything that is already correct unchanged (variables, alignments).

RULES
Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once as sN+letter(+digits); reentrancy by bare variable; every graph variable has one alignment line (start-end of numbered words; 0-0 for abstract nodes, entity type nodes, name nodes, language nodes, date-entity, omitted persons); document level refers only to existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time). Omit empty groups.

Graph: NO :modstr, :modpred, :quot (delete them; modality is only in the document level). Attributes lowercase: :aspect {state, habitual, endeavor, process, performance, activity}, :refer-person 3rd, :refer-number singular/plural, :polarity -, :mode. Ordinary nouns/adjectives/adverbs/classifiers keep their Chinese form (never market/television/small/part). Abstract concepts and entity types are English. Top node: 因此/有见于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause); 并/而/则 clause linking -> and. Roles: :possessor (not :poss), :place (not :location), :source/:end-state, :manner, :medium, :mod, :quant + :unit (classifier kept), ARGn-of for relative clauses. Names: type + :name with one :opN per segmented word. Planning verbs endeavor, their complements/purposes process, states state, completed events performance.

Document level:
:temporal - (parent :rel child); rel in {:before :after :overlap :contained :depends-on}; each child exactly once; no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; absolute date: (document-creation-time :before sNd) + (sNd :overlap main event); previous sentence main event :overlap current main event; main event :overlap its complement/purpose/coordinated events; cause :before effect.
:modal - (author :full-affirmative e) for every event of the graph (including embedded ones); labels full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified; negated event full-negative; for a complement of a 无意/表示-type predicate also (cpt :unspecified complement).
:coref - (earlier :same-entity current) for pronouns, zero pronouns, repeated named entities across sentences; :same-event for repeated events; previous mention first; existing variables only.

Before answering: every event has :aspect and an author modal edge; alignments cover every variable; only the three sections are output.
operations.reason: Apply findings under the gold conventions and keep stable format; remove obsolete modstr rules.

tests:
ANN = '# sentence level graph:
(s1x / plan-01
    :ARG0 (s1p / person
        :ref-person 3rd
        :ref-number Singular)
    :aspect State
    :modstr FullAff)

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1
s1p: 0-0

# document level annotation:
(s1s0 / sentence
    :temporal ((PAST_REF :overlap s1x))
    :modal ((AUTH :FullAff s1x)))'
out = run(ANN, {'index': 1, 'text': ''})
assert ':modstr' not in out
assert 'PAST_REF' not in out
assert ':temporal' not in out
assert '(author :full-affirmative s1x)' in out
assert ':refer-person 3rd' in out and ':refer-number singular' in out
assert ':aspect state' in out

ANN2 = '# sentence level graph:
(s1x / change-01
    :aspect performance
    :modstr NeutNeg
    :polarity -)

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1

# document level annotation:
(s1s0 / sentence)'
out2 = run(ANN2, {'index': 1, 'text': ''})
assert '(author :neutral-negative s1x)' in out2
assert ':modal' in out2
assert out2.count('(') == out2.count(')')

ANN3 = '# sentence level graph:
(s1x / a
    :aspect process
    :ARG1 (s1y / b
        :aspect process))

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1
s1y: 2-2

# document level annotation:
(s1s0 / sentence
    :temporal ((s1x :overlap s1y)
               (DCT :before s1y)
               (DCT :before s1x))
    :modal ((AUTH :Unsp s1y)))'
out3 = run(ANN3, {'index': 1, 'text': ''})
assert '(s1x :overlap s1y)' in out3
assert 'before s1y' not in out3
assert '(document-creation-time :before s1x)' in out3
assert '(author :unspecified s1y)' in out3
assert '(author :full-affirmative s1x)' in out3

ANN4 = 'garbage without sections'
assert run(ANN4, {'index': 1, 'text': ''}) == ANN4
operations.reason: Deterministically normalise document-level vocabulary and graph attributes to the gold conventions: strip :modstr/:modpred/:quot (turning modstr into author edges), map modal labels to full names, author/document-creation-time, drop tense metanodes, one temporal parent per child, lowercase aspect/refer values, author edge for every event.

suggestions: Gold annotations are internally inconsistent in places (aspect of planning verbs vs complements; 电视 as name part vs mod; unspecified modal edges only sometimes); the judge penalises these regardless.
Gold segmentation sometimes lemmatises differently from the input tokens (售予 -> 售, 调往 aligned to only 往); not learned.
Consider a future tool that looks up PropBank-zh rolesets to choose sense numbers (发展-05) and ARG numbering.

:coref - (earlier :same-entity current) for entities mentioned before: pronouns, zero-pronoun nodes, repeated named companies/places/languages (same name) -> link to the most recent variable of that entity, including variables of earlier sentences; :same-event for repeated events. Previous mention first.

TASK: audit the current UMR annotation of the Chinese sentence and return findings only. Do NOT rewrite it. Each finding = one line: `[section] problem -> fix` (quote the exact node/relation, give corrected text). Say nothing about checks that pass. Order by importance; prefer the guideline's coarse conservative defaults. End with "NO OTHER ISSUES" if nothing remains.

CHECKLIST
1. Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once, reentrancy by bare variable; every graph variable has one alignment line; alignment numbers fit the numbered words; abstract/entity-type/name/date/language/omitted nodes aligned 0-0; document level refers only to existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time).
2. Graph attributes: NO :modstr, :modpred, :quot anywhere in the graph (modality only at document level). Attributes lowercase (:aspect performance, :refer-person 3rd, :refer-number singular); :ref-person/:ref-number are wrong names. No :refer-number on ordinary nouns.
3. Concepts: ordinary nouns/adjectives/adverbs/classifiers stay Chinese (市场, 电视, 小, 部分), never English translations (market, television, small, part). English only for abstract concepts and entity types. Event nodes for all predicates / event nominals; none for auxiliaries (会 能 了 着 过), light verbs, modifiers.
4. Top node: result connectives 因此/所以/有见于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause); clause linking 并/而/则 -> `and` (not contrast-91/but-91); sentence-initial 然而 is not a but-91 wrapper; purpose/condition/concession etc. as :purpose/:condition/:concession on the main event.
5. Roles: numbered ARGn on lexical predicates, correct direction; participants omitted but recoverable present as person/thing (0-0). Peripheral roles: :possessor (not :poss), :place (not :location or :mod for locations), :source/:end-state for 转型, :manner for adverbs like 逐渐, :medium for language of programmes/channels, :mod for origin place of a noun (香港移民), relative clauses as :ARGn-of. Classifiers kept as :unit with :quant; partitive 小部分 -> X :quant (部分 :mod 小). Named entities: type + :name with one :opN per segmented word (whole name incl. 电视/集团), no :name on common nouns like 电视台.
6. Aspect on every event, lowercase: planning verbs endeavor; their complement/purpose events process; states/relative-clause 讲 state; completed bounded events performance; repeated broadcasts habitual; event nominals process.
7. Temporal: (parent :rel child); every child exactly once (no event with two parents); no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; time expression :overlap its event; absolute date under document-creation-time :before; previous main event :overlap current main event for continuing narrative; main event :overlap its complement/purpose/coordinated events; cause :before effect.
8. Modal: (author :full-affirmative e) for EVERY event in the graph (complements, embedded, relative-clause events too); labels only from: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified (never FullAff/PrtAff/AUTH); negated events full-negative; complement of a 无意/表示-type predicate also (cpt :unspecified complement). Only events as modal children (no company/person nodes).
9. Coref: (earlier :same-entity current) for pronouns, zero-pronoun nodes and repeated named entities (same company/place/language across sentences) - check that obvious repeats are linked to the latest earlier variable; no link to nonexistent variables.
10. Consistency with context: role names and concept forms follow earlier sentences.

Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once as sN+letter(+digits); reentrancy by bare variable; every graph variable has one alignment line (start-end of numbered words; 0-0 for abstract nodes, entity type nodes, name nodes, language nodes, date-entity, omitted persons); document level refers only to existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time). Top node: 因此/有见于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause); 并/而/则 clause linking -> and. Roles: :possessor (not :poss), :place (not :location), :source/:end-state, :manner, :medium, :mod, :quant + :unit (classifier kept), ARGn-of for relative clauses. Names: type + :name with one :opN per segmented word. Planning verbs endeavor, their complements/purposes process, states state, completed events performance.

Document level:
:temporal - (parent :rel child); rel in {:before :after :overlap :contained :depends-on}; each child exactly once; no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; absolute date: (document-creation-time :before sNd) + (sNd :overlap main event); previous sentence main event :overlap current main event; main event :overlap its complement/purpose/coordinated events; cause :before effect.
:modal - (author :full-affirmative e) for every event of the graph (including embedded ones); labels full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified; negated event full-negative; for a complement of a 无意/表示-type predicate also (cpt :unspecified complement).

Before answering: every event has :aspect and an author modal edge; alignments cover every variable; only the three sections are output.

operations.text:
TASK: annotate the Chinese sentence in UMR (numbered roles, aspect; modality only at document level). Work in this order.

0. CONCEPTS. Reuse variables of earlier sentences for coreference; copy their conventions. Ordinary nouns, adjectives-as-modifiers, adverbs, classifiers keep the CHINESE word without sense (市场, 小, 反复, 位, 个, 场). NEVER translate them. English only for abstract concepts (and, consecutive, contrast-91, have-reason-91, have-condition-91, have-concession-91, have-91, identity-91, date-entity, temporal-quantity), entity types and omitted nodes.
PREDICATES: call lookup_frame(lemma) for every verb and every adjective/state predicate. Frame exists -> lemma-01 (or the listed sense) with :ARG0/:ARG1... as the frame says. NO FRAME -> lemma-00 with :actor (agent) and :undergoer (patient) instead of ARGn (e.g. an exam-start, re-take, infection verb).
GRAPH ATTRIBUTES allowed: :aspect (lowercase), :polarity -, :mode, :degree, :refer-number, :refer-person, :quant. NO :modstr/:modpred/:quot.

1. EVENTS. Events: verbs, adjective/state predicates (痛苦 好玩 坚定: write 痛苦-01 :ARG0 the experiencer, aspect state; do NOT use have-mod-91 for them), participles and relative-clause verbs (喜欢的学校: 学校 :ARG1-of (喜欢-01 :ARG0 person :polarity -)). NOT events: auxiliaries/aspect words (了 着 过 会 能 开始), light verbs (进行/做), and abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持 事): keep them as plain nouns without :aspect and without modal edge. Use have-91 for 有 (ARG1 owner, ARG2 possessed); identity-91 for 这是X.

2. TOP NODE / CONNECTIVES. One main event -> that event. Plain juxtaposition or 并/而 -> `and` (:op1 :op2 ...). Sequence 于是/然后/接着 -> (consecutive :op1 :op2). 但/然而 joining two clauses -> (contrast-91 :ARG1 first :ARG2 second). 因此/所以/由于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause) ONLY for real cause-effect. 要…才 / 如果 -> (have-condition-91 :ARG1 consequent :ARG2 condition). 在…情况下仍然 / 虽然 -> (have-concession-91 :ARG1 main :ARG2 concession). 为了: :purpose; 通过: :manner; 之前/之后/前/后: 前 or 后 node with :op1 the reference event/date, under :temporal.
Speech/reporting verbs (表示 直言 提到): :ARG0 speaker, :ARG1 content, :ARG2 addressee (对X表示 -> X is :ARG2).

3. PARTICIPANTS. Pronouns and zero subjects whose antecedent is in the SAME sentence or is the evident protagonist: REUSE that variable (bare reentrancy, e.g. :ARG0 s3p). Do NOT create new person nodes for 他 其 or omitted subjects, and no :refer-person on them; no coref link for them. Only if the referent has no node anywhere in this sentence: (p / person :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) aligned 0-0, and link by coref to the earlier mention. Demonstratives 这/此 are their own concept with :refer-number singular (这是决定: identity-91 :ARG1 (这 :refer-number singular) :ARG2 决定). Named person: (p / person :name (n / name :op1 "阿耀")).

4. NON-CORE RELATIONS. :mod for properties, types, demonstratives AND ADVERBS (反复 仍然 只 只能 无法 重新 -> :mod; 十分/更 on adjectives -> :degree); :possessor; :place; :temporal; :purpose; :cause; :topic; :source; :end-state; :medium; :part-of; :frequency; :quant; :unit; :name; :opN.
Quantity: numeral + classifier = separate concept nodes: noun :quant (一) :unit (位), each aligned to its own word. Digits with units/dates stay constants (:quant 1). Vague 许多/一些 -> :quant "一些". Dates: (d / date-entity :year 2022 :month 4 :day 21), aligned 0-0; 年底 -> (年底 :part-of (date-entity :year 2022)); 今日 -> (今日 :temporal date-entity).
Named entities: (x / TYPE :name (n / name :op1 ... one :opN per segmented word)), whole name incl. generic noun inside it. TYPES: universities/schools/companies/agencies -> organization; media outlet (维基新闻) -> newspaper; exam or event names (DSE) -> event; festival (圣诞 元旦) -> festival; facility/centre/hospital -> facility; drug/commercial product -> product; disease/epidemic names (COVID-19) -> disease; place -> city / country / country-region; person -> person. Type node and name node aligned 0-0. Do not invent extra entity nodes for common nouns (电视台, 胶囊 stay plain words).

5. ASPECT on every event (lowercase): performance (completed/bounded events and reports: 表示 加入 渡过 染疫 康复 访问 给 参加 听闻 感到-in-past), state (adjective/state predicates, 喜欢 感兴趣 有 identity-91, relative-clause states), activity (ongoing/continuing/unbounded actions: 坚持 读 温书 and the action being persisted in), process (ongoing happenings like 震荡, 重考 as a purpose), habitual (regular), endeavor ONLY for 计划/打算/试图 style verbs. Negation: :polarity - on the event. No :aspect on plain nouns.

6. ALIGNMENT. Every variable gets `var: start-end` using the word numbers of the input. Concept -> its single word (or its idiom/compound token). Abstract nodes (and, consecutive, contrast-91, have-*-91, date-entity, entity type nodes, name nodes, omitted persons) -> 0-0. Never align a node to a wide span of several words; numerals and classifiers get their own words.

7. DOCUMENT LEVEL (sNs0 / sentence), groups :temporal :modal :coref.
:temporal (parent :rel child), each child once. Anchor events to document-creation-time rather than chaining to earlier sentences: past completed (performance) events -> (document-creation-time :before e); states and generic/present statements -> (document-creation-time :overlap e); content of a speech/report and non-actual events -> (document-creation-time :depends-on e). Inside the sentence: sequential events (consecutive, 于是) :before/:after; time-clause or duration events :overlap/:contained; embedded relative-clause/purpose events :overlap their head. Skip unclear relations. NEVER PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF.
:modal (author :full-affirmative e) for each VERBAL event (not for nouns or abstract connectives). 未/没 + verb -> full-negative; 不 on a state or relative-clause verb (不喜欢 不感兴趣) -> keep full-affirmative with :polarity - in the graph; 不得不/必须/应该 -> partial-affirmative; 可能 -> neutral-affirmative. Labels: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified.
:coref (earlier :same-entity current): link only to the nearest earlier mention (previous sentence variable) of a repeated entity (named person, institution, language) that gets its own NEW node in this sentence. No coref for reentrant variables inside one sentence.

OUTPUT only the three sections. Check: parentheses balanced; each variable declared once; every variable has an alignment line; every event has :aspect and an author modal edge.

TASK: audit the current UMR annotation of the Chinese sentence and return findings only. Do NOT rewrite it. Each finding = one line: `[section] problem -> fix` (quote exact node/relation). Say nothing about checks that pass. Order by importance. If the annotation is missing or empty, say only: `NO ANNOTATION`. End with "NO OTHER ISSUES" if nothing remains.

CHECKLIST (gold conventions)
1. Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once; reentrancy by bare variable; every variable has exactly one alignment line with numbers inside the sentence; abstract/type/name/date nodes/omitted nodes 0-0; no wide multi-word spans for single concepts (numeral and classifier have their own words); document level uses only existing variables, author, document-creation-time.
2. Pronouns/zero subjects: a 他/其/omitted subject must reuse the antecedent variable (reentrancy), NOT a new (person :refer-person ...) node, and NOT a coref link. Flag any such new node. :refer-number only on 这/此 concepts or on a referent with no antecedent.
3. Predicates: call lookup_frame on doubtful verbs/adjectives. Frame exists -> -01 with ARGn; no frame -> lemma-00 with :actor/:undergoer. Adjective/state predicates are stative X-01 events (not have-mod-91). Abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持) stay plain nouns: no :aspect, no modal edge.
4. Concepts stay Chinese for nouns/adverbs/classifiers. Entity types: universities/schools/companies -> organization; media outlet -> newspaper; exam/event name (DSE) -> event; festival; facility; product; disease; city/country. Names: one :opN per segmented word, whole name inside.
5. Connectives: and (并/juxtaposition), consecutive (于是/然后), contrast-91 with :ARG1 :ARG2 (但), have-reason-91 only for 因此/所以, have-condition-91 (要…才/如果), have-concession-91 (虽然/在…情况下仍然). Speech verbs: ARG0 speaker, ARG1 content, ARG2 addressee.
6. Relations: adverbs (反复 仍然 只 只能 无法) -> :mod, degree words -> :degree; numeral+classifier -> separate nodes under :quant/:unit; :possessor; :place; :temporal; no :modstr/:modpred/:quot.
7. Aspect lowercase on every event: performance (completed, speech), state (adjectives/states), activity (ongoing actions like 坚持 读 温书), process (ongoing happenings), endeavor only for plan/intend verbs.
8. Temporal: each child once; events anchored to document-creation-time (:before past performance, :overlap states, :depends-on speech content/generic), not chained to previous-sentence events; no PAST_REF etc.
9. Modal: (author :full-affirmative e) for verbal events only; 未/没 full-negative; 不 on states keeps full-affirmative + :polarity -; 不得不/必须 partial-affirmative; never FullAff/AUTH.
10. Coref: only previous-sentence mention -> new node of the same entity; none for pronouns reusing a variable.

TASK: produce the final, complete UMR annotation (all three sections, nothing else). Start from the current annotation; apply each finding that is correct under the rules below (silently reject findings that contradict them); also fix any other violation. Keep everything already correct unchanged (variables, alignments). If no annotation is given, annotate the sentence from scratch with these rules.

RULES
Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once as sN+letter(+digits); reentrancy by bare variable; every variable has one alignment line (single word number or start-end of the concept's own word(s); 0-0 for abstract nodes, entity type nodes, name nodes, date-entity, omitted persons); document level uses only existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time). Omit empty groups.

Graph: NO :modstr/:modpred/:quot. Attributes lowercase. Nouns/adverbs/classifiers keep Chinese form. Predicates with a PropBank frame: lemma-01 + ARGn; without: lemma-00 + :actor/:undergoer. Adjective/state predicates are stative X-01 events (not have-mod-91). Pronouns (他 其) and zero subjects reuse the antecedent variable (no new person node, no :refer-person, no coref). Abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持) stay plain nouns, no :aspect, no modal. Adverbs -> :mod; degree words -> :degree; numeral and classifier -> separate :quant and :unit nodes. Entity types: organization (schools, universities, companies), newspaper, event (DSE), festival, facility, product, disease, city/country, person; type and name nodes 0-0; one :opN per segmented word. Connectives: and; consecutive for 于是; contrast-91 with :ARG1 :ARG2; have-reason-91 only 因此/所以; have-condition-91; have-concession-91. Aspect: performance (completed, speech), state, activity (ongoing actions: 坚持 读 温书), process, endeavor only for plan/intend verbs.

Document level:
:temporal - (parent :rel child), rel in {:before :after :overlap :contained :depends-on}; each child once; anchor to document-creation-time (:before past performance; :overlap states; :depends-on speech content/generic); local relations among events of the same sentence; no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; no links to previous-sentence events.
:modal - (author :full-affirmative e) for every verbal event; 未/没 full-negative; 不 on states stays full-affirmative with :polarity -; 不得不/必须 partial-affirmative; labels full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified.
:coref - (earlier :same-entity current) only for a repeated entity that has a new node here, linked to the nearest earlier variable; existing variables only.

Before answering: every event has :aspect and an author modal edge; every variable has an alignment line; only the three sections are output.

suggestions: Gold is inconsistent in places: numerals sometimes constants (:quant 1) and sometimes nodes (一/位); 退 has a PropBank frame but gold writes 退-00; 不 negation gets full-affirmative in some relative clauses but full-negative for 未; temporal graph mixes root/present-reference/document-creation-time with :depends-on. Do not over-fit these.
If generate fails to parse (as in sentence 2), the critique step sees no annotation; the harness should retry or pass the last parsable draft.

op.text:
TASK: annotate the Chinese sentence in UMR (numbered roles, aspect; modality only at document level). Work in this order.

0. CONCEPTS. Reuse variables of earlier sentences for coreference; copy their conventions. Ordinary nouns, adjectives-as-modifiers, adverbs, classifiers keep the CHINESE word without sense (市场, 小, 反复, 位, 个, 场). NEVER translate them. English only for abstract concepts (and, consecutive, contrast-91, have-reason-91, have-condition-91, have-concession-91, have-91, identity-91, date-entity, temporal-quantity), entity types and omitted nodes.
PREDICATES: call lookup_frame(lemma) for every verb and every adjective/state predicate. Frame exists -> lemma-01 (or the listed sense) with :ARG0/:ARG1... as the frame says. NO FRAME -> lemma-00 with :actor (agent) and :undergoer (patient) instead of ARGn (e.g. an exam-start, re-take, infection verb).
GRAPH ATTRIBUTES allowed: :aspect (lowercase), :polarity -, :mode, :degree, :refer-number, :refer-person, :quant. NO :modstr/:modpred/:quot.

1. EVENTS. Events: verbs, adjective/state predicates (痛苦 好玩 坚定: write 痛苦-01 :ARG0 the experiencer, aspect state; do NOT use have-mod-91 for them), participles and relative-clause verbs (喜欢的学校: 学校 :ARG1-of (喜欢-01 :ARG0 person :polarity -)). NOT events: auxiliaries/aspect words (了 着 过 会 能 开始), light verbs (进行/做), and abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持 事): keep them as plain nouns without :aspect and without modal edge. Use have-91 for 有 (ARG1 owner, ARG2 possessed); identity-91 for 这是X.

2. TOP NODE / CONNECTIVES. One main event -> that event. Plain juxtaposition or 并/而 -> `and` (:op1 :op2 ...). Sequence 于是/然后/接着 -> (consecutive :op1 :op2). 但/然而 joining two clauses -> (contrast-91 :ARG1 first :ARG2 second). 因此/所以/由于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause) ONLY for real cause-effect. 要…才 / 如果 -> (have-condition-91 :ARG1 consequent :ARG2 condition). 在…情况下仍然 / 虽然 -> (have-concession-91 :ARG1 main :ARG2 concession). 为了: :purpose; 通过: :manner; 之前/之后/前/后: 前 or 后 node with :op1 the reference event/date, under :temporal.
Speech/reporting verbs (表示 直言 提到): :ARG0 speaker, :ARG1 content, :ARG2 addressee (对X表示 -> X is :ARG2).

3. PARTICIPANTS. Pronouns and zero subjects whose antecedent is in the SAME sentence or is the evident protagonist: REUSE that variable (bare reentrancy, e.g. :ARG0 s3p). Do NOT create new person nodes for 他 其 or omitted subjects, and no :refer-person on them; no coref link for them. Only if the referent has no node anywhere in this sentence: (p / person :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) aligned 0-0, and link by coref to the earlier mention. Demonstratives 这/此 are their own concept with :refer-number singular (这是决定: identity-91 :ARG1 (这 :refer-number singular) :ARG2 决定). Named person: (p / person :name (n / name :op1 "阿耀")).

4. NON-CORE RELATIONS. :mod for properties, types, demonstratives AND ADVERBS (反复 仍然 只 只能 无法 重新 -> :mod; 十分/更 on adjectives -> :degree); :possessor; :place; :temporal; :purpose; :cause; :topic; :source; :end-state; :medium; :part-of; :frequency; :quant; :unit; :name; :opN.
Quantity: numeral + classifier = separate concept nodes: noun :quant (一) :unit (位), each aligned to its own word. Digits with units/dates stay constants (:quant 1). Vague 许多/一些 -> :quant "一些". Dates: (d / date-entity :year 2022 :month 4 :day 21), aligned 0-0; 年底 -> (年底 :part-of (date-entity :year 2022)); 今日 -> (今日 :temporal date-entity).
Named entities: (x / TYPE :name (n / name :op1 ... one :opN per segmented word)), whole name incl. generic noun inside it. TYPES: universities/schools/companies/agencies -> organization; media outlet (维基新闻) -> newspaper; exam or event names (DSE) -> event; festival (圣诞 元旦) -> festival; facility/centre/hospital -> facility; drug/commercial product -> product; disease/epidemic names (COVID-19) -> disease; place -> city / country / country-region; person -> person. Type node and name node aligned 0-0. Do not invent extra entity nodes for common nouns (电视台, 胶囊 stay plain words).

5. ASPECT on every event (lowercase): performance (completed/bounded events and reports: 表示 加入 渡过 染疫 康复 访问 给 参加 听闻 感到-in-past), state (adjective/state predicates, 喜欢 感兴趣 有 identity-91, relative-clause states), activity (ongoing/continuing/unbounded actions: 坚持 读 温书 and the action being persisted in), process (ongoing happenings like 震荡, 重考 as a purpose), habitual (regular), endeavor ONLY for 计划/打算/试图 style verbs. Negation: :polarity - on the event. No :aspect on plain nouns.

6. ALIGNMENT. Every variable gets `var: start-end` using the word numbers of the input. Concept -> its single word (or its idiom/compound token). Abstract nodes (and, consecutive, contrast-91, have-*-91, date-entity, entity type nodes, name nodes, omitted persons) -> 0-0. Never align a node to a wide span of several words; numerals and classifiers get their own words.

7. DOCUMENT LEVEL (sNs0 / sentence), groups :temporal :modal :coref.
:temporal (parent :rel child), each child once. Anchor events to document-creation-time rather than chaining to earlier sentences: past completed (performance) events -> (document-creation-time :before e); states and generic/present statements -> (document-creation-time :overlap e); content of a speech/report and non-actual events -> (document-creation-time :depends-on e). Inside the sentence: sequential events (consecutive, 于是) :before/:after; time-clause or duration events :overlap/:contained; embedded relative-clause/purpose events :overlap their head. Skip unclear relations. NEVER PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF.
:modal (author :full-affirmative e) for each VERBAL event (not for nouns or abstract connectives). 未/没 + verb -> full-negative; 不 on a state or relative-clause verb (不喜欢 不感兴趣) -> keep full-affirmative with :polarity - in the graph; 不得不/必须/应该 -> partial-affirmative; 可能 -> neutral-affirmative. Labels: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified.
:coref (earlier :same-entity current): link only to the nearest earlier mention (previous sentence variable) of a repeated entity (named person, institution, language) that gets its own NEW node in this sentence. No coref for reentrant variables inside one sentence.

OUTPUT only the three sections. Check: parentheses balanced; each variable declared once; every variable has an alignment line; every event has :aspect and an author modal edge.

TASK: audit the current UMR annotation of the Chinese sentence and return findings only. Do NOT rewrite it. Each finding = one line: `[section] problem -> fix` (quote exact node/relation). Say nothing about checks that pass. Order by importance. If the annotation is missing or empty, say only: `NO ANNOTATION`. End with "NO OTHER ISSUES" if nothing remains.

CHECKLIST (gold conventions)
1. Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once; reentrancy by bare variable; every variable has exactly one alignment line with numbers inside the sentence; abstract/type/name/date nodes/omitted nodes 0-0; no wide multi-word spans for single concepts (numeral and classifier have their own words); document level uses only existing variables, author, document-creation-time.
2. Pronouns/zero subjects: a 他/其/omitted subject must reuse the antecedent variable (reentrancy), NOT a new (person :refer-person ...) node, and NOT a coref link. Flag any such new node. :refer-number only on 这/此 concepts or on a referent with no antecedent.
3. Predicates: call lookup_frame on doubtful verbs/adjectives. Frame exists -> -01 with ARGn; no frame -> lemma-00 with :actor/:undergoer. Adjective/state predicates are stative X-01 events (not have-mod-91). Abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持) stay plain nouns: no :aspect, no modal edge.
4. Concepts stay Chinese for nouns/adverbs/classifiers. Entity types: universities/schools/companies -> organization; media outlet -> newspaper; exam/event name (DSE) -> event; festival; facility; product; disease; city/country. Names: one :opN per segmented word, whole name inside.
5. Connectives: and (并/juxtaposition), consecutive (于是/然后), contrast-91 with :ARG1 :ARG2 (但), have-reason-91 only for 因此/所以, have-condition-91 (要…才/如果), have-concession-91 (虽然/在…情况下仍然). Speech verbs: ARG0 speaker, ARG1 content, ARG2 addressee.
6. Relations: adverbs (反复 仍然 只 只能 无法) -> :mod, degree words -> :degree; numeral+classifier -> separate nodes under :quant/:unit; :possessor; :place; :temporal; no :modstr/:modpred/:quot.
7. Aspect lowercase on every event: performance (completed, speech), state (adjectives/states), activity (ongoing actions like 坚持 读 温书), process (ongoing happenings), endeavor only for plan/intend verbs.
8. Temporal: each child once; events anchored to document-creation-time (:before past performance, :overlap states, :depends-on speech content/generic), not chained to previous-sentence events; no PAST_REF etc.
9. Modal: (author :full-affirmative e) for verbal events only; 未/没 full-negative; 不 on states keeps full-affirmative + :polarity -; 不得不/必须 partial-affirmative; never FullAff/AUTH.
10. Coref: only previous-sentence mention -> new node of the same entity; none for pronouns reusing a variable.

TASK: produce the final, complete UMR annotation (all three sections, nothing else). Start from the current annotation; apply each finding that is correct under the rules below (silently reject findings that contradict them); also fix any other violation. Keep everything already correct unchanged (variables, alignments). If no annotation is given, annotate the sentence from scratch with these rules.

RULES
Form: balanced parentheses; each variable declared once as sN+letter(+digits); reentrancy by bare variable; every variable has one alignment line (single word number or start-end of the concept's own word(s); 0-0 for abstract nodes, entity type nodes, name nodes, date-entity, omitted persons); document level uses only existing variables or constants (author, document-creation-time). Omit empty groups.

Graph: NO :modstr/:modpred/:quot. Attributes lowercase. Nouns/adverbs/classifiers keep Chinese form. Predicates with a PropBank frame: lemma-01 + ARGn; without: lemma-00 + :actor/:undergoer. Adjective/state predicates are stative X-01 events (not have-mod-91). Pronouns (他 其) and zero subjects reuse the antecedent variable (no new person node, no :refer-person, no coref). Abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持) stay plain nouns, no :aspect, no modal. Adverbs -> :mod; degree words -> :degree; numeral and classifier -> separate :quant and :unit nodes. Entity types: organization (schools, universities, companies), newspaper, event (DSE), festival, facility, product, disease, city/country, person; type and name nodes 0-0; one :opN per segmented word. Connectives: and; consecutive for 于是; contrast-91 with :ARG1 :ARG2; have-reason-91 only 因此/所以; have-condition-91; have-concession-91. Aspect: performance (completed, speech), state, activity (ongoing actions: 坚持 读 温书), process, endeavor only for plan/intend verbs.

Document level:
:temporal - (parent :rel child), rel in {:before :after :overlap :contained :depends-on}; each child once; anchor to document-creation-time (:before past performance; :overlap states; :depends-on speech content/generic); local relations among events of the same sentence; no PAST_REF/PRESENT_REF/FUTURE_REF; no links to previous-sentence events.
:modal - (author :full-affirmative e) for every verbal event; 未/没 full-negative; 不 on states stays full-affirmative with :polarity -; 不得不/必须 partial-affirmative; labels full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified.
:coref - (earlier :same-entity current) only for a repeated entity that has a new node here, linked to the nearest earlier variable; existing variables only.

Before answering: every event has :aspect and an author modal edge; every variable has an alignment line; only the three sections are output.

reflect.reflection: The small generator follows the skill literally. The skill pushed three conventions the gold does not use: every event is anchored to document-creation-time, modal edges go to verbal events only, and 有 maps to have-91. The critic enforced the same wrong rules and added its own: align 但, use :location, delete state modals, and change modality from world knowledge. Finalize then applied those findings. I change four things. (1) The temporal rule becomes: only the main event links to document-creation-time, and the other events hang on a related event in the same sentence. (2) Every event, states included, gets a modal edge. (3) New compact gold conventions cover quantities, ordinals, entity types, place, aspect, idioms, coverage of all clauses, and broader coref. (4) A rule step repairs the alignment section, because comma lists were silently turned into 0-0. I also correct the critique and finalize steps so they stop undoing gold conventions.

import re


def run(annotation: str, sentence: dict) -> str:
    """Normalize the alignment section of a UMR annotation.

    Every variable declared in the sentence-level graph gets exactly one
    alignment line of the form 'var: start-end' (the first span if several are
    given, '0-0' if missing). Alignment lines for undeclared variables are
    dropped. Returns the annotation unchanged if the sections are not found.
    """
    i1 = annotation.find('# alignment:')
    i2 = annotation.find('# document level annotation:')
    if i1 < 0 or i2 < i1:
        return annotation
    g = annotation[:i1]
    a = annotation[i1:i2]
    d = annotation[i2:]
    decl = []
    for v in re.findall(r'\(\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*/', g):
        if v not in decl:
            decl.append(v)
    seen = {}
    for ln in a.split('\n')[1:]:
        m = re.match(r'\s*([^\s:]+)\s*:\s*(.*)$', ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        v = m.group(1)
        val = m.group(2).strip()
        sp = re.match(r'(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)', val)
        if sp:
            lo, hi = int(sp.group(1)), int(sp.group(2))
            if lo > hi:
                lo, hi = hi, lo
            new = '%d-%d' % (lo, hi)
        else:
            n = re.match(r'(\d+)', val)
            new = '%s-%s' % (n.group(1), n.group(1)) if n else '0-0'
        if v not in seen:
            seen[v] = new
    lines = ['%s: %s' % (v, seen.get(v, '0-0')) for v in decl]
    return g.rstrip() + '\n\n# alignment:\n' + '\n'.join(lines) + '\n\n' + d.strip() + '\n'

import re

INV = {':before': ':after', ':after': ':before', ':overlap': ':overlap', ':depends-on': ':depends-on'}
PAT = re.compile(r'\(\s*([^\s()]+)\s+(:before|:after|:overlap|:depends-on)\s+document-creation-time\s*\)')


def run(annotation: str, sentence: dict) -> str:
    """Rewrite temporal edges that have document-creation-time as the child so that
    document-creation-time is the parent (inverting :before/:after)."""
    i = annotation.find('# document level annotation:')
    if i < 0:
        return annotation
    head, doc = annotation[:i], annotation[i:]
    doc = PAT.sub(lambda m: '(document-creation-time %s %s)' % (INV[m.group(2)], m.group(1)), doc)
    return head + doc
tests:

(a / b)
# document level annotation:
(s5s0 / sentence :temporal ((s5x :depends-on document-creation-time)))', {'index':5,'text':''})

10. ROUND-7 RULES.
- Relative clause: head = doer -> :ARG0-of (货车 :ARG0-of 运送-01); head = patient -> :ARG1-of. P+于/以 predicates (致力于 用于 用以 位于) = ONE concept; its subject is a bare reentrant :ARG0.
- 第一辆汽车: 汽车 :ord (ordinal-entity :value 1 :unit (辆)); no :unit on the noun.
- 前/后 + quantity (事发前两天, 发生前一小时): (temporal-quantity :quant (一/两 as own node on its word) :unit (天) :mod (前 :op1 event)) as :temporal. Digits stay constants. Document level: (tq :contained main-event), (document-creation-time :before tq); the main event gets no DCT link.
- 在A后，B (no quantity) -> (consecutive :op1 A :op2 B ...), no 后 node; later event :after earlier.
- V1到X上V2 (移动到车上逃跑): V2 is :purpose of V1. 用X (tool) -> :instrument.
- 约N公吨: 约 :mod, N :quant, 公吨 :unit, all on the noun; no quantity node.
- No nodes for 尔后 首先 立刻. Weapon/vehicle owner -> :possessor on that noun. International NGO/aid body -> international-organization.

TASK: annotate the Chinese sentence in UMR (numbered roles, aspect; modality only at document level). Work in this order.

0. CONCEPTS. Reuse variables of earlier sentences for coreference; copy their conventions. Ordinary nouns, adjectives-as-modifiers, adverbs, classifiers keep the CHINESE word without sense (市场, 小, 反复, 位, 个, 场). NEVER translate them. English only for abstract concepts (and, consecutive, but-91, contrast-91, have-reason-91, have-condition-91, have-concession-91, have-degree-91, have-91, identity-91, date-entity, temporal-quantity), entity types and omitted nodes. A verb concept is the WHOLE segmented word (杀掉 侦破 掌权), never trimmed.
PREDICATES: call lookup_frame(lemma) for every verb and every adjective/state predicate. Frame exists -> lemma-01 (or the listed sense; never invent -02/-03) with :ARG0/:ARG1... as the frame says. NO FRAME -> lemma-00 with :actor (agent) and :undergoer (patient).
GRAPH ATTRIBUTES allowed: :aspect (lowercase), :polarity -, :mode, :degree, :refer-number, :refer-person, :quant. NO :modstr/:modpred/:quot.

1. EVENTS. Events: verbs, adjective/state predicates (痛苦 好玩 坚定: 痛苦-01 :ARG0 experiencer, aspect state; NOT have-mod-91), participles and relative-clause verbs (喜欢的学校: 学校 :ARG1-of (喜欢-01 :ARG0 person :polarity -); the doer head of a relative clause takes :ARG0-of). NOT events: auxiliaries/aspect words (了 着 过 会 能 开始), light verbs (进行/做), abstract/attitude nouns (原因 压力 目标 决定 鼓励 支持 事): plain nouns, no :aspect, no modal edge. 有 -> 有-01 (:ARG0 owner/locus, :ARG1 thing had); identity-91 for 这是X.

2. TOP NODE / CONNECTIVES. One main event -> that event. Juxtaposition or 并/而 -> `and` (:op1 :op2 ...). A comma clause with its own verb (no 的) is a coordinated `and` clause, never :mod of the preceding noun. 于是/然后/接着 -> (consecutive :op1 :op2). 但/然而 joining two clauses -> (contrast-91 :ARG1 first :ARG2 second); sentence-initial 但是 contrasting with the previous sentence -> (but-91 :ARG1 this clause's event), no ARG2. 因此/所以/由于 -> have-reason-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause) ONLY when cause and effect are both in this sentence; if the cause is in an earlier sentence: no have-reason-91, put :reason (t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) 0-0 on the effect event and coref (earlier cause event :same-event t). 要…才 / 如果 -> (have-condition-91 :ARG1 consequent :ARG2 condition). 在…情况下仍然 / 虽然 -> (have-concession-91 :ARG1 main :ARG2 concession). 为了: :purpose; 通过: :manner. X前/X后 with an explicit X (25年前): 前/后 node :op1 X (date or temporal-quantity) under :temporal. 当…时: the clause event itself is :temporal of the main event (no 后 node). Bare adverb 之后/随后: concept 之后 as :temporal, no :op1, no implicit-argument.
Speech/reporting verbs (表示 直言 提到): :ARG0 speaker, :ARG1 content, :ARG2 addressee (对X表示 -> X is :ARG2).

3. PARTICIPANTS. Pronoun or zero subject whose antecedent is in the SAME sentence or is the evident protagonist: REUSE that variable (bare reentrancy); no new person node, no :refer-person, no coref. EXPLICIT pronoun (他们 他 她 它) whose antecedent is in an EARLIER sentence: new node (p / person :refer-person 3rd :refer-number plural|singular) (它: thing), aligned 0-0, plus coref (earlier :same-entity p), or (earlier :subset-of p) when it picks part of an earlier group. OMITTED/passive argument whose antecedent is in an EARLIER sentence: (x / implicit-argument) 0-0 + coref. Never use earlier-sentence variables in the graph. Demonstratives 这/此 are their own concept with :refer-number singular (这是决定: identity-91 :ARG1 (这 :refer-number singular) :ARG2 决定). Named person: (p / individual-person :name (n / name :op1 "阿耀")); a repeated name gets a new node + coref. 二人/两人: (人 :quant 2) aligned to the word, coref :subset-of the earlier group.

4. NON-CORE RELATIONS. :mod for properties, types, demonstratives AND ADVERBS (反复 仍然 只 亦 还 无法 重新 -> :mod; 十分/更 on adjectives -> :degree). Manner word (连手 一起) -> plain concept under :manner (not -00, no :actor). Attributive 最X -> (N :ARG1-of (have-degree-91 :ARG2 X :ARG3 最)). Locative modifier noun (地下矿坑) -> 矿坑 :place 地下. Passive 被: patient :ARG1; tool/weapon noun after 被 -> :instrument. Others: :possessor; :place; :temporal; :purpose; :cause; :topic; :source; :end-state; :medium; :part-of; :frequency; :quant; :unit; :name; :opN.
Quantity: numeral + classifier = separate concept nodes: noun :quant (一) :unit (位), each aligned to its own word. Digits with units/dates stay constants (:quant 1). Dates: (d / date-entity :year 2022 :month 4 :day 21), aligned 0-0; 年底 -> (年底 :part-of (date-entity :year 2022)); 今日 -> (今日 :temporal date-entity).
Named entities: (x / TYPE :name (n / name :op1 ... one :opN per segmented word)), whole name incl. generic noun inside it. TYPES: universities/schools/companies/agencies -> organization; media outlet -> newspaper; exam or event names (DSE) -> event; festival (圣诞 元旦) -> festival; facility/centre/hospital -> facility; drug/commercial product -> product; disease names -> disease; place -> city / country / country-region / island; person -> individual-person. Type node and name node aligned 0-0. Common nouns (电视台, 胶囊) get no entity node.

5. ASPECT on every event (lowercase): performance, state (adjective/state predicates, 喜欢 感兴趣 有 identity-91, relative-clause states), activity (ongoing/continuing/unbounded actions: 坚持 读 温书), process (ongoing happenings like 震荡, 重考 as a purpose), habitual (regular; generic customs, 通常), endeavor ONLY for 计划/打算/试图. Negation: :polarity - on the event. No :aspect on plain nouns.

6. ALIGNMENT. Every variable gets `var: start-end` (word numbers of the input). Concept -> its single word (or idiom token). Abstract nodes (and, consecutive, but-91, contrast-91, have-*-91, date-entity, entity type, name nodes, omitted persons, pronoun person nodes, implicit-argument) -> 0-0, even if 但/虽然/他们 is present. Never align a node to a wide span; numerals and classifiers get their own words.

7. DOCUMENT LEVEL (sNs0 / sentence), groups :temporal :modal :coref.
:temporal (parent :rel child), each child once. DIRECTION: (P :after C) means C happens AFTER P; (P :before C) means C happens BEFORE P. So a past event is (document-creation-time :before e) and two sequential events are (earlier :after later). Main event: first sentence / no earlier event: past performance -> (document-creation-time :before e); states and generic/present statements -> (document-creation-time :overlap e); speech content and non-actual events -> (document-creation-time :depends-on e). Later sentence of a running narrative: link its main event to the main event of the PREVIOUS sentence ((prev :after cur) if cur follows, (prev :overlap cur) if simultaneous/continuing, (prev :before cur) if earlier) and NO DCT link; copy this if the preceding annotations already do. Every other event hangs off a related event IN THIS SENTENCE (embedded, time-clause, purpose, relative-clause, coordinated-state events :overlap their head; sequences by DIRECTION). An explicit date-entity is the parent of its event: (date :overlap event), no DCT link, never :depends-on a date. Skip unclear relations.
:modal (author :full-affirmative e) for EVERY event incl. state/adjective events (not plain nouns, manner words or connectives). 未/没 -> full-negative; 不 on a state or relative-clause verb -> full-affirmative with :polarity -; 不得不/必须/应该 -> partial-affirmative; 可能 -> neutral-affirmative. Labels: full-affirmative partial-affirmative neutral-affirmative full-negative partial-negative neutral-negative unspecified.
:coref (earlier :same-entity current): nearest earlier mention of a repeated entity (named person, institution, language, definite repeats (这种习俗, 金币); not a bare topic noun repeated in every sentence) that gets its own NEW node here; (earlier :subset-of current) for partitives 其中/部分 and 二人 picking part of a group; (earlier :same-event placeholder) for 因此. None for reentrant variables inside one sentence.

8. GOLD CONVENTIONS.
- COVERAGE: annotate every clause to the end (…，不但A，而且B / ，并且C -> `and` with all parts). Every content word gets a node or sits in an idiom concept. Idioms/4-char predicates (截然不同 难得一见) = ONE -01 concept.
- No nodes for 也 曾 另外 已经 就 都 要 会; 更多 = one :quant concept. 终于 -> :temporal. 特别 -> :mod. Reason clause of an event -> :reason. Place words (西岸 在X) -> :place; 地区/国家 :part-of the country node.
- 多种 = 多 (:quant) + 种 (:unit), 这种 = 这 (:mod) + 种 (:unit), separate nodes. 部分/许多 -> :quant node. 超过N万 -> (more-than :op1 100000) as :quant of the noun with the classifier as :unit. 第一年 -> (temporal-quantity :quant 1 :unit 年 :ord (ordinal-entity :value 1)); 第N届/第N次: :ord (ordinal-entity :value N :unit (届/次 node on its own word)).
- Aspect: general/typical statements -> habitual; 授权/存在/有 -> state; negated 没有出现 -> performance + :polarity -.
- Purpose/complement verbs (确保 想) reuse the subject variable as :ARG0.
- X中有Y: (exist-91 :ARG1 (中 :op1 X) :ARG2 Y :aspect state). 在X有Y -> 有-03 :ARG0 X :ARG1 Y, state. 有+NP+V: no 有 node; the NP is V's :ARG0.
- 评为/评选为: 评为-01 :ARG1 person :ARG2 award.
- Types: named 国会/铸币局 -> government-organization (bare 政府 stays 政府); army -> armed-organization; legislature/party -> political-organization; 周报/杂志 -> magazine; prize title -> award; law -> law; 美国 -> country; named version/product (1870-S版) -> product :name. Keep the exact surface noun (会上, not 会议); 音乐X -> :topic; 中国X -> :mod (country :name); X地区的N -> N :place 地区.

operations.code:
import re

PAT = re.compile(r'\(\s*root\s+:modal\s+author\s*\)')


def run(annotation: str, sentence: dict) -> str:
    """Ensure the document-level :modal group contains (root :modal author), creating the group if absent."""
    i = annotation.find('# document level annotation:')
    if i < 0:
        return annotation
    head, doc = annotation[:i], annotation[i:]
    if PAT.search(doc):
        return annotation
    m = re.search(r':modal\s*\(', doc)
    if m:
        k = m.end()
        doc = doc[:k] + '(root :modal author)\n            ' + doc[k:]
    else:
        s = doc.rstrip()
        k = s.rfind(')')
        if k < 0:
            return annotation
        doc = s[:k] + '\n    :modal ((root :modal author))' + s[k:] + '\n'
    return head + doc

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1

# document level annotation:

    :modal ((author :full-affirmative s1x)))
'
r = run(a, {'index': 1, 'text': 'x'})
assert '((root :modal author)' in r and '(author :full-affirmative s1x)' in r

b = '# sentence level graph:
(s1x / a)

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1

# document level annotation:
(s1s0 / sentence
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :before s1x)))
'
r2 = run(b, {'index': 1, 'text': 'x'})
assert ':modal ((root :modal author))' in r2 and r2.count('(s1s0') == 1

c = '# sentence level graph:
(s1x / a)

# alignment:
s1x: 1-1

# document level annotation:
(s1s0 / sentence
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s1x)))
'
assert run(c, {'index': 1, 'text': 'x'}) == c

op.code:
import re

PAT = re.compile(r'\(\s*root\s+:modal\s+author\s*\)')


def run(annotation: str, sentence: dict) -> str:
    """Ensure the document-level :modal group contains (root :modal author), creating the group if absent."""
    i = annotation.find('# document level annotation:')
    if i < 0:
        return annotation
    head, doc = annotation[:i], annotation[i:]
    if PAT.search(doc):
        return annotation
    m = re.search(r':modal\s*\(', doc)
    if m:
        k = m.end()
        doc = doc[:k] + '(root :modal author)\n            ' + doc[k:]
    else:
        s = doc.rstrip()
        k = s.rfind(')')
        if k < 0:
            return annotation
        doc = s[:k] + '\n    :modal ((root :modal author))' + s[k:] + '\n'
    return head + doc

reflect.reflection: Most of the lost score is format, not understanding. The skills taught a vocabulary (:ref-person, Singular, :modstr, :modpred, :Str, DCT) that the gold and the judge do not use. The critique step then reinforced it, and it even moved the temporal relation the wrong way. I will change four things. (1) I rewrite all three skills to use the gold conventions: :refer-person/:refer-number/:aspect in lowercase, no :modstr in the graph, :modal-predicate on the complement, hyphenated modal labels, author as conceiver, (root :modal author), no DCT, and correct temporal direction ((A :after B) means B is after A). I also add the construction rules seen here (concession, truth-value, adjective events, particles, neg-raising, implicit things). (2) I add a deterministic rule step, run after generate and again after finalize, that normalises attribute names and cases, converts :modstr into the document-level modal labels and then drops it, rewrites :modpred var to :modal-predicate var, maps modal label variants, adds the root modal tuple, and removes DCT/ROOT/*_REF temporal tuples. This fixes the small model's inconsistency by code. (3) I add a roleset_lookup tool over propbank-en-args.txt, so haiku picks real senses and roles instead of guessing, for example whether an adjective has a frame. (4) I rewrite the critic to check against the same conventions.

operations.reason: Exact sense/role lookup that small models do badly (full-09, important-01, get-05, dump-01 roles vs :goal).

operations.text:
TASK: annotate ONE English sentence in UMR (PropBank-style numbered roles) in EXACTLY the conventions below. Reuse variables of the 5 previous sentences for coref and temporal links. For every event verb/adjective call roleset_lookup(lemma) to pick the sense and check which roles are core (-01 if no roleset fits).

1. EVENTS
Events: predicated verbs, states, non-verbal clauses; event nominals (storm, meeting); participles; gerunds; infinitives; relative-clause verbs.
NOT events: modal/tense auxiliaries (will, would, can, may, must, should, have, be, do); phasal verbs (start, keep, stop, finish: only aspect); the light verb of light verb + eventive noun (use the noun, interview-01); adjectives/state nouns used as modifiers; entity nouns.
- Predicate adjectives/nouns that have a PropBank roleset ARE events: "X is important" -> (i/ important-01 :ARG1 X :aspect state); "the basket is full" -> (f/ full-09 :ARG1 basket :ARG2 (t/ thing)) (an unexpressed ARG2 = implicit thing, aligned 0-0, coref to the earlier noun it stands for). Use have-mod-91 etc. only if roleset_lookup finds nothing.
- A particle after get/go/come (down, up, out, away) is its own concept: "gets down out of the tree" -> (g/ get-05 :ARG1 mover :ARG2 (d/ down-03) :source tree). Do not fuse into get-down-01. Directional/locative PPs that are not core roles: :goal (into, to), :source (out of, from), :place, :path.
- Sentence-initial But/However (contrast with the previous sentence): root (h/ have-concession-91 :ARG1 (e/ event) :ARG2 <main clause>); h aligned to the connective, e aligned 0-0, coref (earlier-event :same-event e). h has no aspect.
- "know/ask/wonder if/whether X (or not)": (k/ know-01 :ARG1 (t/ truth-value :polarity-of (x/ X-event ...))); t aligned to "if"; do not build or/have-mod pairs for "or not".
- "I don't think/believe/expect X": the negation goes on X (:polarity - on X's event), not on think.
- "make/let X do" = two events. Add implicit events only when sure.

2. ROOT
One main event is root; complement, adverbial, relative events hang under it. Clear relation (:purpose :cause :condition :concession :manner :temporal before/after/while) -> role under the main event. No clear relation: root = and / or (:op1 :op2) or contrast-91 / but-91 / unexpected-co-occurrence-91 (:ARG1 :ARG2). A clause that starts with and/and then just continues the narrative: annotate the clause itself as root (no and node); the link is in the document-level temporal group. Non-verbal clauses: abstract predicate is root: have-91 (ARG1 possessor, ARG2 possessum), belong-91 (possessum, possessor), exist-91 (location, theme), have-place-91 (theme, location), have-mod-91 (theme, property), have-role-91 (theme, reference, category), have-org-role-92 (theme, org, title), have-rel-role-92 (theme, relative, role), identity-91 (theme, equated).

3. CONCEPTS AND ROLES
- Events: PropBank lemma-sense. Nouns: plain lemma. Time words are concepts under :temporal: (t/ then), (a/ at-first), (t/ today), (n/ now).
- Pronouns/implicit people: (p/ person :refer-person 1st|2nd|3rd :refer-number singular|plural). Generic "you" adds :refer-definiteness class. Common nouns: :refer-number singular|plural. Named entities: type + (n/ name :op1 ..) + :wiki, no refer-person. Pronoun "that/this" = (t/ thing :mod (d/ that)) with t aligned to the word and d 0-0.
- Core roles per roleset; reentrancy by shared variable (control: wants to go -> go :ARG0 same person). Passive: same roles as active. Inverse roles for modifying events: (p/ person :ARG0-of (r/ run-02)).
- Kinship/titles: (p/ person :ARG1-of (h/ have-rel-role-92 :ARG2 rel :ARG3 (f/ father))) and have-org-role-92.
- Non-core: :temporal :place :manner :purpose :cause :condition :concession :duration :frequency :direction :path :extent :goal :source; noun relations :mod :poss (owner; possessum is parent) :part :topic :medium :age :group :example :quant (all, numbers) :unit :ord :li :polite :degree. Measures: substance is the head (three cups of milk -> milk :quant 3 :unit cup).
- Dates: date-entity (:year :month :day :weekday :time). Durations: temporal-quantity :quant :unit. Negation: :polarity - on the negated concept.

4. ATTRIBUTES in the graph (all lowercase values, written after roles)
- :aspect on each event except abstract have-concession-91: process (event nominal) > habitual (generic/usual, used to) > state (be/have/love/know/want/think/see, perception, mental, ability, non-verbal, adjective events) > activity (progressive/present, no end, start/keep) > endeavor (stopped, for-duration) > performance (completed or future; default; telic motion or transfer like dump, get down). imperfective / perfective only if unsure.
- :mode imperative | interrogative | expressive on the main verb; imperatives get a 2nd-person ARG0.
- DO NOT write :modstr or :modpred in the graph. The complement of a modal-type predicate (want, need, think, believe, expect, hope, try, plan, decide, know-if, allow, forbid) stays its ARG1 and ALSO gets :modal-predicate <predicate variable> (bare variable). Speech-verb complements are plain ARG1.

5. ALIGNMENT: one line per variable, `var: start-end` (1-based; one word -> `5-5`); pronoun person node = the pronoun; name and type nodes = name span; connectives = their word; have-concession-91 = the But; truth-value = the "if"; implicit/abstract nodes 0-0.

6. DOCUMENT LEVEL (omit empty groups; use only variables that exist in this or the previous sentences; never DCT, ROOT, PAST_REF etc.)
:temporal (parent :rel child): rel describes the CHILD relative to the PARENT, so (A :after B) means B happens after A; (A :before B) means B is before A; (A :overlap B); (A :contained B) means B is inside A. Entries: (time-expression-node :contained event) for an overt time expression (at first, then); otherwise link the event to the nearest relevant earlier event: narrative sequence (and then, next action) -> (earlier :after current); same time (state, comment) -> (earlier :overlap current); complement of think/know -> (earlier-context-event :overlap complement). If nothing clear, give no temporal tuple.
:modal starts with (root :modal author); then (author :label event). Labels: full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified. Plain asserted event: (author :full-affirmative e). Cues: will, plain assertion, manage -> full-affirmative; probably, should, must, imperative, intend/plan, think/believe -> partial-affirmative; may, might, can, want, hope, maybe -> neutral-affirmative; not, never, deny -> full-negative; probably not, forbid -> partial-negative; doubt, "don't think X" -> neutral-negative; "know if X (or not)", "John does not know whether X" -> unspecified. For a modal-type predicate give a tuple ONLY for the complement (strength computed from the whole construction), none for the predicate itself. Conditional: (author :neutral-affirmative cond-node), then the clauses.
:coref (earlier :same-entity current): pronouns, implicit arguments (implicit thing/person) and repeated mentions -> the nearest earlier variable of the same entity. :same-event for repeated events and for event anaphora (that/it/this referring to an earlier event; the implicit event of have-concession-91). :subset-of for subsets. No coref for generic or unrelated nodes.

Skeleton:
(s3g / get-05
    :ARG1 (s3p / person :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular)
    :ARG2 (s3d / down-03)
    :aspect performance)
...

You review one UMR annotation of one sentence and return findings. Do NOT rewrite it. Output a numbered list; each item = location | problem | exact fix. Say nothing about correct parts. If nothing is wrong output "No problems." Most serious first. Judge against THESE conventions (do not suggest others):

A. FORMAT: balanced parentheses; each variable defined once as (x/ concept), later uses bare; variables sN+letter(+digits); every graph variable has exactly one alignment line (1-based, 0-0 only for abstract/implicit nodes; connectives and have-concession-91 aligned to their word). Attribute names are :refer-person (1st|2nd|3rd), :refer-number (singular|plural), :aspect, :polarity -, :mode; all values lowercase. The graph has NO :modstr and NO :modpred.

B. EVENTS/ROOT: auxiliaries, phasal verbs, light verbs, modifier adjectives not events; real predicated events present. Predicate adjectives/nouns that have a PropBank roleset (important-01, full-09) are events, not have-mod-91. A particle after get/go (down, up) is its own concept (down-03), not fused. Sentence-initial But/However contrasting with the previous sentence = have-concession-91 with :ARG1 implicit (e/ event). "know if X (or not)" = truth-value :polarity-of X. Root is the main event; purpose/cause/condition/concession roles hang under it; and/or/contrast-91 root only for unrelated coordination. Narrative "and (then)" clause is its own root. Non-verbal clauses use the right abstract predicate and ARG order, aspect state.

C. PARTICIPANTS: ARG roles per PropBank (ARG0 agent, ARG1 patient/theme; for motion verbs without an agent role the mover may be ARG1); non-core goal/source/place phrases use :goal :source :place, not an invented ARGn; shared variables for control/relative clauses; pronouns and implicit participants are person/thing with refer-person and refer-number; common nouns have :refer-number; named entities type + name + wiki; time words are concepts under :temporal; :quant for all/numbers; :poss for owners; "I don't think X": polarity on X's event, not on think; overt negation present.

D. ASPECT: lowercase; nominal process > habitual > state (incl. think/know/see/be/adjective events) > activity > endeavor > performance. Telic motion/transfer = performance.

E. COMPLEMENTS: the complement of want/need/think/believe/hope/try/plan/decide/know-if/allow carries :modal-predicate <predicate var>.

F. DOCUMENT LEVEL: groups :temporal :modal :coref. Temporal tuples (parent :rel child) mean the CHILD is :rel the PARENT: (A :after B) = B after A. So a later narrative event B after A is (A :after B); NEVER (A :before B). No DCT/ROOT/PAST_REF constants: delete such tuples. Time-expression node: (t :contained event). Modal group starts with (root :modal author); then (author :label event) with labels full-affirmative, partial-affirmative, neutral-affirmative, full-negative, partial-negative, neutral-negative, unspecified; invalid labels (:str, :Str, :FullAff, :Unsp...) must be replaced. A modal-type predicate (think, know-if, want) gets no tuple itself; its complement gets one with the construction's strength ("don't think X" neutral-negative; "know if X" unspecified; want neutral-affirmative). Coref: (earlier :same-entity current); event anaphora and the implicit event use :same-event; implicit things/persons are linked to the earlier noun; only existing variables.

You get the sentence, the current annotation and critique findings. Output the complete corrected annotation (the three sections only). Apply findings that are correct under the RULES below; ignore findings that contradict them. Also fix any other error. Do not change correct material. Call roleset_lookup(lemma) when a sense or role is in doubt. Self-check: variables defined once, parentheses balanced, one alignment line per graph variable (1-based; 0-0 abstract/implicit), document-level variables exist, empty groups omitted.

RULES
